name: side-drawer
title: Side Drawer
description: A navigation drawer that springs in from the side as its rows follow one by one; drag it back to close.

perf.budget: A transparent modal of plain views; the panel, scrim and rows read two shared values. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: p99 spikes are the first frame of the modal window opening.

a11y.reducedMotion: The drawer appears and disappears without sliding, rows included.
a11y.screenReader: Rows are menu items with a selected state; outside the panel is a "Close menu" button, and Back closes it.
a11y.touchTarget: Rows are 48 pt tall and nearly the full width of the panel.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add side-drawer`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
